description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—when processing audio and noise inputs. The horizontal axis represents the model names, listed alphabetically, and the vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)” and ranging from 0 to 60 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each model, two bars are displayed: a blue bar representing “Audio” and a purple bar representing “Noise”. Additionally, a dashed gray horizontal line is present, labeled “Random Choice”, and positioned at 30% accuracy. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the blue “Audio” bar reaches approximately 47% accuracy, while the purple “Noise” bar reaches approximately 24%. For Audio-Reasoner, the blue “Audio” bar is approximately 54% and the purple “Noise” bar is approximately 16%. Finally, for Qwen-2.5-Omni, the blue “Audio” bar is about 42% and the purple “Noise” bar reaches approximately 28%. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
